Use case: stylized-concept. Production JRPG sprite atlas for ABYSS DOMINION Chapter II. BRAND NEW ORIGINAL CHARACTER, one heroine repeated in EXACTLY EIGHT distinct full-body poses, 4 columns x 2 rows, landscape 2:1 canvas. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT PNG RGBA background with empty alpha zero; no white background, no checkerboard, no ground, no shadows, no captions or grid lines.
STYLE: match the user's favorite detailed Lilica hooded violet sword and Aure pink angel knight references visible in conversation: adorable expressive anime face and large bright eyes, petite heroic FOUR-HEAD-TALL proportions (head height one quarter of standing body height), elegant ornate layered armor, fine antique gold engraving and jewel accents, detailed PIXEL-ART-STYLE shaded sprite rendering with crisp pixel edges. Cute face, cool formidable weapon and costume. Not toddler superdeformed, not realistic adult six-head anatomy. Fully clothed armored fantasy heroine.
POSES left to right: top row 1 idle relaxed, 2 idle breathing hair/sleeve subtly shifted, 3 battle-ready sword/weapon raised across torso, 4 walking right left foot forward; bottom row 5 walking right opposite foot forward, 6 dramatic attack to the RIGHT with a sharp compact colored slash attached to the weapon, 7 recoiling from damage eyes shut body leaning back, 8 defeated kneeling eyes closed weapon lowered. ALL eight images same character identity, body scale, costume, weapon. Front three-quarter facing SCREEN RIGHT, nose and toes point right, NEVER left. One figure per cell. Generous clear transparent gaps; everything including long weapons, cape, attack effect and hair must fit wholly within its own cell. Each sprite roughly 300-400px tall at source, consistent feet alignment within each row, sharp silhouettes legible at 224px runtime. Limited localized magic, no enormous glowing aura.
Keep a minimum transparent safety margin around the whole canvas and between all eight figures. No cropped weapon tips, no adjacent silhouettes touching.
